newsitem.title: USA: Brown sees FY96 EPS in $1.10-$1.15 range.
newsitem.headline: Brown sees FY96 EPS in $1.10-$1.15 range.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said it views as "probably more realistic" earnings per share estimates for the year ended February 1 in the $1.10 to $1.15 range, below current analysts' estimates in the $1.17 to $1.33 range.

"Below-planned retail results lead to somewhat reduced earnings expectations for the company, despite continuing very encouraging wholesale business. For the year, an earnings per share range of $1.10 to $1.15 is probably more realistic than the $1.17 to $1.33 current range of analyst estimates," Brown said.
The shoe retailer earned $0.04 per share on an operating basis after charges in its fiscal 1995 ended in February 1996.
